wiki.title: James Malone (American politician)
wiki.extract: James Andrew Malone (born 1973 or 1974) is an American politician who has served as a member of the Pennsylvania Senate from the 36th district since 2025. A Democrat, he was first elected in a March 2025 special election to succeed Republican senator Ryan Aument, who resigned in December 2024. Malone previously served as mayor of East Petersburg, Pennsylvania.
